_comment: DISCOVERY-ONLY manifest for phase 2 of the workspace-graph bench. These pins exercise `init-workspace --scan` member DISCOVERY across declaration formats. They are NOT part of the mined task corpus: build_tasks_ws.py reads corpus.json and does not read this file. Adding any of these to corpus.json would change what the miner mines and would invalidate the frozen 215-task set in tasks/tasks_ws.json and the 0010 gate bars. Per-member task quota for every entry here is 0 by construction.
_bounds: Registered in README.md 'Phase 2': <=1 member per format, checkout <=500 MB, <=3 candidate repos evaluated per format, OSS + permissive licence + exact tag/commit pin, declaration format present ORGANICALLY (never synthesised). No qualifying candidate => format recorded UNCOVERED and the search STOPS.
_not_vendored: vite and babel are not checked out under bench/repos/ — they were shallow-cloned at the pinned tag, probed with internal/workspace.Members, and discarded. The pin is the record; re-fetch with `git clone --depth 1 --branch <pin>`. symfony and nest are already on disk under bench/repos/.

formats.note: Pre-existing coverage; also a mined corpus member (nest-common / nest-core) via corpus.json, which is unchanged by this file.
Organic: composer.json declares two `type: path` repositories. Discovery of the root itself is separate from symfony's role as a mined corpus member.

Organic pnpm-workspace.yaml declaring packages/*, playground/**, packages/**/__tests__/** and docs. Exercises the recorded `**` limitation in internal/workspace/members.go: the ** patterns degrade to single-level globs, so playground/** matches one level and packages/**/__tests__/** matches nothing.
Organic package.json `workspaces` array: codemods/*, eslint/*, packages/*, test/esm, test/runtime-integration/*, benchmark.

formats.reason: Three candidates evaluated (the registered bound) and none declares a root go.work: grafana/loki, open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector, tailscale/tailscale — all 404 for go.work at HEAD. The on-disk Go repos (gin v1.10.0, prometheus v3.1.0, client_golang v1.20.5) have no go.work either and discover 0 members. Bound reached; search STOPPED rather than widened.

Structural, not a search failure: Python has no declaration source in member discovery. internal/workspace/members.go reads exactly five sources — go.work, pnpm-workspace.yaml, composer.json path repositories, lerna.json, package.json workspaces — and none is Python. pyproject.toml/setup.py/setup.cfg appear only in memberMarkers, i.e. as evidence that an already-declared candidate is a real member, never as a declaration of members. So no Python repo, organic or otherwise, can be discovered. Candidates evaluated on disk: flask 3.1.0 (single root package; the examples/ subprojects are not declared anywhere) and werkzeug 3.1.3 (single package); both discover 0 members. Covering this format requires an engine change, not a corpus change.
